questions.question_english:
After Kerala, which of the following states or union territories has the highest
scheduled caste sex ratio?
questions.question_hindi: केरल के बाद, निम्नलिखित में से किस राज्य या संघ शासित प्रदेश का अनुसूचित जाति लिंग अनुपात सबसे अधिक है?
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is Option A: Puducherry. According to the census data, after Kerala, Puducherry has the highest scheduled caste sex ratio. This is due to various socio-economic factors that contribute to a balanced gender ratio in the scheduled caste population. The other options, while having significant populations of scheduled castes, do not have as high a sex ratio as Puducherry.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प A: पुदुच्चेरी है। जनगणना के आंकड़ों के अनुसार, केरल के बाद पुदुच्चेरी का अनुसूचित जाति लिंग अनुपात सबसे अधिक है। यह विभिन्न सामाजिक-आर्थिक कारकों के कारण है जो अनुसूचित जाति जनसंख्या में संतुलित लिंग अनुपात में योगदान करते हैं। अन्य विकल्पों में, जबकि अनुसूचित जातियों की महत्वपूर्ण जनसंख्या है, पुदुच्चेरी के समान उच्च लिंग अनुपात नहीं है।
questions.explanation: The correct answer is Option A: Puducherry. According to the census data, after Kerala, Puducherry has the highest scheduled caste sex ratio. This is due to various socio-economic factors that contribute to a balanced gender ratio in the scheduled caste population. The other options, while having significant populations of scheduled castes, do not have as high a sex ratio as Puducherry.

questions.question_english: Who among the following gave the three laws of planetary motion?
questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से किसने ग्रहों की गति के तीन नियम दिए?
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is Option C: Kepler. Johannes Kepler formulated the three laws of planetary motion, which describe the orbits of planets around the sun. Newton later built upon Kepler's laws with his law of universal gravitation. Rutherford and Faraday are known for their contributions to atomic theory and electromagnetism, respectively, but not for planetary motion.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प C: केपलर है। जोहान्स केपलर ने ग्रहों की गति के तीन नियमों का निर्माण किया, जो सूर्य के चारों ओर ग्रहों की कक्षाओं का वर्णन करते हैं। न्यूटन ने बाद में केपलर के नियमों पर अपने सार्वभौमिक गुरुत्वाकर्षण के नियम के साथ निर्माण किया। रदरफोर्ड और फाराडे क्रमशः परमाणु सिद्धांत और विद्युतचुम्बकत्व में अपने योगदान के लिए जाने जाते हैं, लेकिन ग्रहों की गति के लिए नहीं।
questions.explanation: The correct answer is Option C: Kepler. Johannes Kepler formulated the three laws of planetary motion, which describe the orbits of planets around the sun. Newton later built upon Kepler's laws with his law of universal gravitation. Rutherford and Faraday are known for their contributions to atomic theory and electromagnetism, respectively, but not for planetary motion.

questions.question_english:
In which of the following diseases does a parasite develop in the red blood cells
(RBCs) of humans?
questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से किस रोग में परजीवी मानव के लाल रक्त कोशिकाओं (RBCs) में विकसित होता है?
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is Option D: Malaria. Malaria is caused by the Plasmodium parasite, which infects red blood cells in humans. questions.explanation: The correct answer is Option D: Malaria. Malaria is caused by the Plasmodium parasite, which infects red blood cells in humans. The other diseases listed do not involve a parasite developing within red blood cells. Covid-19 is a viral infection, Avian influenza is also viral, and Dengue is caused by a virus transmitted by mosquitoes.

questions.question_english:

questions.explanation: The correct answer is Option B: Buddhism. The Ajanta caves are famous for their rock-cut Buddhist monuments and paintings. They are a significant part of Buddhist heritage in India. The other religions listed do not have a direct connection to the Ajanta caves.

questions.question_english:

questions.question_english: Which of the following dance forms was also known as ‘Dasi Attam’ in ancient times?
questions.question_hindi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा नृत्य रूप प्राचीन समय में 'दासी अट्टम' के नाम से भी जाना जाता था?
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is Bharatnatyam. Bharatnatyam is one of the oldest classical dance forms of India and was historically referred to as 'Dasi Attam' as it was performed by temple dancers. The other options, while significant dance forms, do not have this historical association.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर भरतनाट्यम है। भरतनाट्यम भारत के सबसे पुराने शास्त्रीय नृत्य रूपों में से एक है और इसे ऐतिहासिक रूप से 'दासी अट्टम' के नाम से जाना जाता था क्योंकि इसे मंदिर की नर्तकियों द्वारा प्रदर्शन किया जाता था। अन्य विकल्प, जबकि महत्वपूर्ण नृत्य रूप हैं, इस ऐतिहासिक संबंध नहीं रखते।
questions.explanation: The correct answer is Bharatnatyam. Bharatnatyam is one of the oldest classical dance forms of India and was historically referred to as 'Dasi Attam' as it was performed by temple dancers. The other options, while significant dance forms, do not have this historical association.

questions.question_english:
Recently India test fired the surface-to-surface ballistic missile, Agni-5. What type of
fuel engine does the missile have?
questions.question_hindi: हाल ही में भारत ने सतह से सतह पर मार करने वाली बैलिस्टिक मिसाइल, अग्नि-5 का परीक्षण किया। इस मिसाइल में किस प्रकार का ईंधन इंजन है?
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is Solid fuel engine. Agni-5 uses a solid fuel propulsion system, which is known for its reliability and ease of storage. Liquid fuel engines, while powerful, require complex handling and are less stable. The other options do not apply to Agni-5.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर ठोस ईंधन इंजन है। अग्नि-5 ठोस ईंधन प्रोपल्शन प्रणाली का उपयोग करता है, जो अपनी विश्वसनीयता और भंडारण में आसानी के लिए जाना जाता है। तरल ईंधन इंजन, जबकि शक्तिशाली होते हैं, जटिल हैंडलिंग की आवश्यकता होती है और कम स्थिर होते हैं। अन्य विकल्प अग्नि-5 पर लागू नहीं होते।
questions.explanation: The correct answer is Solid fuel engine. Agni-5 uses a solid fuel propulsion system, which is known for its reliability and ease of storage. Liquid fuel engines, while powerful, require complex handling and are less stable. The other options do not apply to Agni-5.

questions.question_english:
The receipts which neither create any liability nor reduce the assets of the
government are called ______.
questions.question_hindi: वे प्राप्तियाँ जो न तो कोई देनदारी उत्पन्न करती हैं और न ही सरकार की संपत्तियों को कम करती हैं, उन्हें ______ कहा जाता है।
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is revenue receipts. Revenue receipts are those that do not create liabilities or reduce assets, such as taxes and fees. Capital receipts, on the other hand, involve transactions that affect the government's liabilities or assets. The other options do not fit this definition.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर राजस्व प्राप्तियाँ हैं। राजस्व प्राप्तियाँ वे होती हैं जो न तो देनदारी उत्पन्न करती हैं और न ही संपत्तियों को कम करती हैं, जैसे कि कर और शुल्क। दूसरी ओर, पूंजी प्राप्तियाँ उन लेनदेन से संबंधित होती हैं जो सरकार की देनदारियों या संपत्तियों को प्रभावित करती हैं। अन्य विकल्प इस परिभाषा में फिट नहीं होते।
questions.explanation: The correct answer is revenue receipts. Revenue receipts are those that do not create liabilities or reduce assets, such as taxes and fees. Capital receipts, on the other hand, involve transactions that affect the government's liabilities or assets. The other options do not fit this definition.

questions.question_english:

questions.explanation: The correct answer is Madhya Pradesh. In November 2022, the state government of Madhya Pradesh notified the implementation of the Panchayat Extension to Scheduled Areas (PESA) Act. This act is significant as it aims to empower local self-governments in Scheduled Areas, ensuring that the rights of the tribal population are protected. The other options, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, and Gujarat, did not make such notifications during this time.

questions.question_english:
Which state has major reserves of low-grade, brown coal called lignite, which is used
for power generation?
